incident.operation: read-only rank0 tail query launched concurrently with a prediction-file listing to the same A6000 SSH alias
incident.error: Connection timed out during banner exchange; connection to 100.86.243.3 port 22 timed out
incident.concurrent_observation: The prediction listing connection to A6000 succeeded and showed the completed imle prediction.

recovery.action: Retried the rank0 query as a single serialized SSH connection with a 10-second connection timeout.
recovery.retry_observation: rank0 reported the completed imle result and continued to ldm_100 at 100/250.

assessment.likely_monitoring_cause: The timeout again affected only one of two concurrent SSH connections to the same host; the other connection and the serialized retry succeeded.
assessment.monitoring_change: The earlier 3090 correction is generalized to every host: no concurrent SSH or SCP sessions will target the same server during experiment monitoring and snapshot collection.
assessment.validation: The subsequent A6000 log/profile copy and prediction copy were intentionally serialized and both completed successfully.
assessment.conclusion: This is a monitoring-control banner timeout, not an experiment failure. The failure and generalized per-host serialization correction are preserved.
